summary: The bytes! wrapper converted an incomplete byte count into bits using unchecked multiplication by 8. Large counts overflowed, causing a panic with overflow checks or an incorrect wrapped size without them. The fix uses checked_mul and returns Err::Failure with ErrorKind::TooLarge when the bit count cannot fit. The regression test added by this commit requests 0x2000000000000000 bytes from empty input, triggering this overflow on a 64-bit target. It is a top-level test in tests/issues.rs; that integration target requires alloc and regexp_macros. The reversal restores both feature variants of bytes_impl! while preserving the new error variant and unchanged regression test. No builds or tests were run.
